theorems.name: zero_is_wf
theorems.proof:
:= by
  rintro h rfl
  cases h with
  | fun_zero_case_0 =>
    exact iswf_num_Inn_of_sizenn (I := Inn.I32) (iswf_fun_sizenn_val _) (iswf_uN_zero _)
  | fun_zero_case_1 =>
    exact iswf_num_Inn_of_sizenn (I := Inn.I64) (iswf_fun_sizenn_val _) (iswf_uN_zero _)
  | fun_zero_case_2 _ =>
    exact iswf_num_Fnn_of_sizenn (F := Fnn.F32) (iswf_fun_sizenn_val _) iswf_fzero_32
  | fun_zero_case_3 _ =>
    exact iswf_num_Fnn_of_sizenn (F := Fnn.F64) (iswf_fun_sizenn_val _) iswf_fzero_64
theorems.notes: Case split on the new fun_zero relation (4 constructors). Integer zeros use iswf_num_Inn_of_sizenn + iswf_uN_zero; float zeros use iswf_num_Fnn_of_sizenn + the shared iswf_fzero_32/_64 (fzero_is_wf is not used). The only Option.get! is on size (valtype_Fnn _), which is `some`. Needs iswf_uN_zero, iswf_fun_sizenn_val and iswf_fzero_32/_64 placed above it (see issues).

theorems.name: dim_is_wf
theorems.proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨_, ⟨_⟩, _, _, hd, _⟩ rfl
  exact hd
theorems.notes: Statement unchanged. The old proof failed only because wf_shape.shape_case_0 gained the var_0 binder and a fun_lsize premise. This destructures the constructor and the dim. No helpers.

theorems.name: unop__is_wf
theorems.proof:
:= by
  rintro h - hn hne rfl
  cases h <;> rename_i hs <;> first
    | exact absurd rfl hne
    | (have hx := iswf_uN_of_num_Inn hn hs
       refine iswf_Forall_cons (iswf_num_Inn_of_sizenn hs ?_) (iswf_Forall_nil _)
       first
        | exact iclz__is_wf _ _ _ hx rfl
        | exact ictz__is_wf _ _ _ hx rfl
        | exact ipopcnt__is_wf _ _ _ hx rfl
        | exact extend___is_wf _ _ _ _ _ (wrap___is_wf _ _ _ _ hx rfl) rfl)
    | (have hx := iswf_fN_of_num_Fnn hn hs
       refine iswf_Forall_map _ _ ?_ (fun _ hy => iswf_num_Fnn_of_sizenn hs hy)
       first
        | exact fabs__is_wf _ _ _ hx rfl
        | exact fneg__is_wf _ _ _ hx rfl
        | exact fsqrt__is_wf _ _ _ hx rfl
        | exact fceil__is_wf _ _ _ hx rfl
        | exact ffloor__is_wf _ _ _ hx rfl
        | exact ftrunc__is_wf _ _ _ hx rfl
        | exact fnearest__is_wf _ _ _ hx rfl)
theorems.notes: New relational statement. Case split on fun_unop_. Case 22 (result none) contradicts var_0 ≠ none, so fun_unop__before_fun_unop__case_22 is never needed. Every other case's width comes from its fun_sizenn premise (rename_i hs): integer cases use the iclz/ictz/ipopcnt/extend/wrap axioms, float cases use iswf_Forall_map with the f*_is_wf axioms. Uses iswf_Forall_map, which must be moved above this theorem (see issues).

theorems.name: testop__is_wf
theorems.proof:
:= by
  rintro h - hn hne rfl
  cases h <;> rename_i hs <;> first
    | exact absurd rfl hne
    | exact iswf_num_I32 (ieqz__is_wf _ _ _ (iswf_uN_of_num_Inn hn hs) rfl)
theorems.notes: New relational statement. Case split on fun_testop_. The none case (case 2) contradicts var_0 ≠ none; fun_testop__before_fun_testop__case_2 is not needed. The result comes from ieqz__is_wf, which is proved in the module and sits above testop__is_wf.

theorems.name: relop__is_wf
theorems.proof:
:= by
  rintro h - hn1 hn2 hne rfl
  cases h
  all_goals first
    | exact absurd rfl hne
    | (rename_i hs
       have h1 := iswf_uN_of_num_Inn hn1 hs
       have h2 := iswf_uN_of_num_Inn hn2 hs
       refine iswf_num_I32 ?_
       first
        | exact ieq__is_wf _ _ _ _ h1 h2 rfl
        | exact ine__is_wf _ _ _ _ h1 h2 rfl)
    | (rename_i hs hr
       have h1 := iswf_uN_of_num_Inn hn1 hs
       have h2 := iswf_uN_of_num_Inn hn2 hs
       refine iswf_num_I32 ?_
       first
        | exact ilt__is_wf _ _ _ _ _ _ hr h1 h2 rfl
        | exact igt__is_wf _ _ _ _ _ _ hr h1 h2 rfl
        | exact ile__is_wf _ _ _ _ _ _ hr h1 h2 rfl
        | exact ige__is_wf _ _ _ _ _ _ hr h1 h2 rfl)
    | (rename_i hs
       have h1 := iswf_fN_of_num_Fnn hn1 hs
       have h2 := iswf_fN_of_num_Fnn hn2 hs
       refine iswf_num_I32 ?_
       first
        | exact feq__is_wf _ _ _ _ h1 h2 rfl
        | exact fne__is_wf _ _ _ _ h1 h2 rfl
        | exact flt__is_wf _ _ _ _ h1 h2 rfl
        | exact fgt__is_wf _ _ _ _ h1 h2 rfl
        | exact fle__is_wf _ _ _ _ h1 h2 rfl
        | exact fge__is_wf _ _ _ _ h1 h2 rfl)
theorems.notes: Statement unchanged. The old proof failed because the constructors gained a var_0 width binder, fun_sizenn premises and (for LT/GT/LE/GE) fun_ilt_-style premises. Three groups: integer EQ/NE (ieq__is_wf/ine__is_wf), integer orderings (ilt/igt/ile/ige__is_wf on the relation premise), and floats (f*_is_wf axioms). The integer theorems are proved in the module and sit above relop. Payload widths come from the case's own fun_sizenn premise, through the inversion helpers.

theorems.name: cvtop___is_wf
theorems.proof:
:= by
  rintro h - hn hne rfl
  cases h
  all_goals first
    | exact absurd rfl hne
    | exact iswf_Forall_cons (reinterpret___is_wf _ _ _ _ hn rfl) (iswf_Forall_nil _)
    | (rename_i hs2 hs1
       have hx := iswf_uN_of_num_Inn hn (iswf_fun_sizenn_of_sizenn1 hs1)
       have hs2 := iswf_fun_sizenn_of_sizenn2 hs2
       first
        | exact iswf_Forall_cons
            (iswf_num_Inn_of_sizenn hs2 (extend___is_wf _ _ _ _ _ hx rfl)) (iswf_Forall_nil _)
        | exact iswf_Forall_cons
            (iswf_num_Inn_of_sizenn hs2 (wrap___is_wf _ _ _ _ hx rfl)) (iswf_Forall_nil _)
        | exact iswf_Forall_cons
            (iswf_num_Fnn_of_sizenn hs2 (convert___is_wf _ _ _ _ _ hx rfl)) (iswf_Forall_nil _))
    | (rename_i hs2 hs1
       have hx := iswf_fN_of_num_Fnn hn (iswf_fun_sizenn_of_sizenn1 hs1)
       have hs2 := iswf_fun_sizenn_of_sizenn2 hs2
       first
        | exact iswf_Forall_list_OMap_imp _ _
            (trunc___is_wf _ _ _ _ _ hx rfl) (fun _ hy => iswf_num_Inn_of_sizenn hs2 hy)
        | exact iswf_Forall_list_OMap_imp _ _
            (trunc_sat___is_wf _ _ _ _ _ hx rfl) (fun _ hy => iswf_num_Inn_of_sizenn hs2 hy)
        | exact iswf_Forall_map _ _
            (promote___is_wf _ _ _ _ hx rfl) (fun _ hy => iswf_num_Fnn_of_sizenn hs2 hy)
        | exact iswf_Forall_map _ _
            (demote___is_wf _ _ _ _ hx rfl) (fun _ hy => iswf_num_Fnn_of_sizenn hs2 hy))
theorems.notes: Statement unchanged. The old proof failed on the new var_1/var_0 binders and the fun_sizenn2 (output) / fun_sizenn1 (input) premises, which are converted to fun_sizenn. REINTERPRET cases use reinterpret___is_wf directly on the input. Integer-input cases use EXTEND/WRAP/CONVERT; float-input cases use TRUNC/TRUNC_SAT (through iswf_Forall_list_OMap_imp, replacing the old iswf_list_OMap_num0) and PROMOTE/DEMOTE (iswf_Forall_map). Case 36 (none) contradicts var_0 ≠ none.

theorems.name: packnum__is_wf
theorems.proof:
:= by
  rintro hn hne rfl
  cases v_lanetype <;> rcases v_num_ with ⟨_ | _, c⟩ | ⟨_ | _, c⟩
  all_goals first
    | exact absurd rfl hne
    | (have hx := iswf_uN_of_num_Inn hn (iswf_fun_sizenn_val _)
       first
        | exact wf_lane_.lane__case_0 _ _ _ _ (fun_lsize.fun_lsize_case_0 (by decide)) hx rfl
        | exact wf_lane_.lane__case_0 _ _ _ _ (fun_lsize.fun_lsize_case_1 (by decide)) hx rfl
        | exact wf_lane_.lane__case_0 _ _ _ _ fun_lsize.fun_lsize_case_4 (wrap___is_wf _ _ _ _ hx rfl) rfl
        | exact wf_lane_.lane__case_0 _ _ _ _ fun_lsize.fun_lsize_case_5 (wrap___is_wf _ _ _ _ hx rfl) rfl)
    | exact wf_lane_.lane__case_1 _ _ _ _ (iswf_fun_sizenn_val _)
        (iswf_fN_of_num_Fnn hn (iswf_fun_sizenn_val _)) rfl
theorems.notes: Statement unchanged; packnum_ is still a def. The old proof failed on wf_lane_'s new var_0 binder and fun_lsize/fun_sizenn premises. This splits lanetype x num_; every packnum_ = none combination is closed by `absurd rfl hne`, so Option.get! is only reduced on `some` values. I8/I16 use wrap___is_wf with fun_lsize_case_4/_5.

theorems.name: unpacknum__is_wf
theorems.proof:
:= by
  rintro hl hne rfl
  cases v_lanetype <;> rcases v_lane_ with ⟨_ | _ | _ | _, c⟩ | ⟨_ | _, c⟩
  all_goals first
    | exact absurd rfl hne
    | exact iswf_num_Inn_of_sizenn (I := Inn.I32) (iswf_fun_sizenn_val _)
        (iswf_uN_of_lane_Jnn hl (fun_lsize.fun_lsize_case_0 (by decide)))
    | exact iswf_num_Inn_of_sizenn (I := Inn.I64) (iswf_fun_sizenn_val _)
        (iswf_uN_of_lane_Jnn hl (fun_lsize.fun_lsize_case_1 (by decide)))
    | exact iswf_num_Fnn_of_sizenn (iswf_fun_sizenn_val _) (iswf_fN_of_lane_Fnn hl (iswf_fun_sizenn_val _))
    | exact iswf_num_Inn_of_sizenn (I := Inn.I32) (iswf_fun_sizenn_val _)
        (extend___is_wf _ _ _ _ _ (iswf_uN_of_lane_Jnn hl fun_lsize.fun_lsize_case_4) rfl)
    | exact iswf_num_Inn_of_sizenn (I := Inn.I32) (iswf_fun_sizenn_val _)
        (extend___is_wf _ _ _ _ _ (iswf_uN_of_lane_Jnn hl fun_lsize.fun_lsize_case_5) rfl)
theorems.notes: Statement unchanged; unpacknum_ is still a def. This splits lanetype x lane_; the none combinations are closed by `absurd rfl hne`. Lane payload widths are read through iswf_uN_of_lane_Jnn / iswf_fN_of_lane_Fnn. I8/I16 use extend___is_wf.

theorems.name: default__is_wf
theorems.proof:
:= by
  rintro hne rfl
  cases v_valtype with
  | I32 =>
    exact wf_val.val_case_0 _ _
      (iswf_num_Inn_of_sizenn (I := Inn.I32) (iswf_fun_sizenn_val _) (iswf_uN_zero _))
  | I64 =>
    exact wf_val.val_case_0 _ _
      (iswf_num_Inn_of_sizenn (I := Inn.I64) (iswf_fun_sizenn_val _) (iswf_uN_zero _))
  | F32 =>
    exact wf_val.val_case_0 _ _
      (iswf_num_Fnn_of_sizenn (F := Fnn.F32) (iswf_fun_sizenn_val _) iswf_fzero_32)
  | F64 =>
    exact wf_val.val_case_0 _ _
      (iswf_num_Fnn_of_sizenn (F := Fnn.F64) (iswf_fun_sizenn_val _) iswf_fzero_64)
  | V128 => exact wf_val.val_case_1 _ _ (by decide) (iswf_uN_zero _)
  | FUNCREF => exact wf_val.val_case_2 _
  | EXTERNREF => exact wf_val.val_case_2 _
  | BOT => exact absurd rfl hne
theorems.notes: Statement unchanged. The old proof used fzero_is_wf, which is false now; F32/F64 use the shared iswf_fzero_32/_64 instead. Each valtype is handled explicitly; BOT is the default_ = none case, closed by `absurd rfl hne`. `default_` here is the Wasm default-value function, not Inhabited.default.

helpers.name: iswf_num_Inn_of_sizenn
helpers.text:
theorem iswf_num_Inn_of_sizenn {I : Inn} {N : Nat} {x : iN} (hN : fun_sizenn (numtype_Inn I) N)
    (hx : wf_uN N x) : wf_num_ (numtype_Inn I) (num_.mk_num__0 I x) := by
  cases hN
  cases I <;> exact wf_num_.num__case_0 _ _ _ (by decide) hx rfl
helpers.notes: Builds wf_num_ for an integer number, with the width taken from fun_sizenn. First user: zero_is_wf (place directly above it; needs only wf_num_, fun_sizenn, numtype_Inn).

helpers.name: iswf_uN_of_num_Inn
helpers.text:
theorem iswf_uN_of_num_Inn {nt : numtype} {I : Inn} {N : Nat} {x : iN}
    (h : wf_num_ nt (num_.mk_num__0 I x)) (hN : fun_sizenn (numtype_Inn I) N) : wf_uN N x := by
  rcases h with ⟨_, _, _, hx, _⟩
  cases hN
  cases I <;> exact hx
helpers.notes: Inversion: the payload of a well-formed integer number fits the fun_sizenn width. First user: unop__is_wf.

helpers.name: iswf_num_Fnn_of_sizenn
helpers.text:
theorem iswf_num_Fnn_of_sizenn {F : Fnn} {N : Nat} {x : fN} (hN : fun_sizenn (numtype_Fnn F) N)
    (hx : wf_fN N x) : wf_num_ (numtype_Fnn F) (num_.mk_num__1 F x) :=
  wf_num_.num__case_1 _ _ _ _ hN hx rfl
helpers.notes: Float counterpart of iswf_num_Inn_of_sizenn (a thin wrapper around num__case_1, kept for symmetry). First user: zero_is_wf.

helpers.name: iswf_fN_of_num_Fnn
helpers.text:
theorem iswf_fN_of_num_Fnn {nt : numtype} {F : Fnn} {N : Nat} {x : fN}
    (h : wf_num_ nt (num_.mk_num__1 F x)) (hN : fun_sizenn (numtype_Fnn F) N) : wf_fN N x := by
  rcases h with _ | ⟨_, _, _, hN', hx, _⟩
  rw [iswf_fun_sizenn_det hN hN']
  exact hx
helpers.notes: Inversion for float numbers. Uses the shared iswf_fun_sizenn_det, which must precede it. First user: unop__is_wf.

helpers.name: iswf_num_I32
helpers.text:
theorem iswf_num_I32 {x : iN} (hx : wf_uN 32 x) : wf_num_ numtype.I32 (num_.mk_num__0 Inn.I32 x) :=
  wf_num_.num__case_0 _ _ _ (by decide) hx rfl
helpers.notes: i32 result of a test or comparison. First user: testop__is_wf; also used by relop__is_wf.

helpers.name: iswf_fun_sizenn_of_sizenn1
helpers.text:
theorem iswf_fun_sizenn_of_sizenn1 {nt : numtype} {N : Nat} (h : fun_sizenn1 nt N) : fun_sizenn nt N := by
  cases h
  exact fun_sizenn.fun_sizenn_case_0 _ ‹_›
helpers.notes: Converts the fun_sizenn1 premise of fun_cvtop__ cases. First user: cvtop___is_wf.

helpers.name: iswf_fun_sizenn_of_sizenn2
helpers.text:
theorem iswf_fun_sizenn_of_sizenn2 {nt : numtype} {N : Nat} (h : fun_sizenn2 nt N) : fun_sizenn nt N := by
  cases h
  exact fun_sizenn.fun_sizenn_case_0 _ ‹_›
helpers.notes: Converts the fun_sizenn2 premise of fun_cvtop__ cases. First user: cvtop___is_wf.

helpers.name: iswf_Forall_list_OMap_imp
helpers.text:
theorem iswf_Forall_list_OMap_imp {α β : Type} {P : β → Prop} {Q : α → Prop} (f : α → β) (o : Option α) :
    Forall Q (Option.toList o) → (∀ x, Q x → P (f x)) → Forall P (list_ β (OMap f o)) := by
  intro h hf
  cases o with
  | none => exact iswf_Forall_nil _
  | some v => exact iswf_Forall_cons (hf v (h v (List.mem_singleton_self v))) (iswf_Forall_nil _)
helpers.notes: The `list_ (OMap f o)` analogue of iswf_Forall_map; it replaces the old specialised iswf_list_OMap_num0. Its statement differs from the old iswf_Forall_list_OMap (which takes Forall (P ∘ f)), hence the new name. Uses iswf_Forall_nil/cons. First user: cvtop___is_wf.

helpers.name: iswf_uN_of_lane_Jnn
helpers.text:
theorem iswf_uN_of_lane_Jnn {lt : lanetype} {J : Jnn} {N : Nat} {x : iN}
    (h : wf_lane_ lt (lane_.mk_lane__0 J x)) (hN : fun_lsize (lanetype_Jnn J) N) : wf_uN N x := by
  rcases h with ⟨_, _, _, hN', hx, _⟩ | _
  rw [iswf_fun_lsize_det hN hN']
  exact hx
helpers.notes: Inversion for integer lanes. Uses the shared iswf_fun_lsize_det. First user: unpacknum__is_wf. Same statement, up to the order of implicit arguments, as g4-vector-b's draft iswf_lane0_payload.

helpers.name: iswf_fN_of_lane_Fnn
helpers.text:
theorem iswf_fN_of_lane_Fnn {lt : lanetype} {F : Fnn} {N : Nat} {x : fN}
    (h : wf_lane_ lt (lane_.mk_lane__1 F x)) (hN : fun_sizenn (numtype_Fnn F) N) : wf_fN N x := by
  rcases h with _ | ⟨_, _, _, hN', hx, _⟩
  rw [iswf_fun_sizenn_det hN hN']
  exact hx
helpers.notes: Inversion for float lanes; lane__case_1 uses fun_sizenn, not fun_lsize. Uses the shared iswf_fun_sizenn_det. First user: unpacknum__is_wf.
